notes:
- Quick entry is one form: the first field is the record type (receivable, payable, collection, payment, income, expense, transfer) and the fields change with it; it opens with Income; the earlier layout with type buttons on top is kept as "Tabbed entry"
- Payments and expenses cannot take more than the cash box holds (also cheque, POS and similar boxes; bank and credit card may go negative), and every payment type shows its current balance in the entry forms, e.g. "Cash (35,675.56)"
- Transfers between accounts and "Account to income": move a balance from one account to another, or turn an overpayment (or a small debt) into income of the chosen type
- New Grid and Tiles themes: the menu groups as tiles in the top bar, all screens as a grid after sign-in, open pages as tabs; screen icons can also be shown as colored tiles (Settings › Screen icons)
- Reports and the account list show amounts in your local currency; "Currency" adds the unit and the foreign amount next to the local amount
- Payment type reports are tabs of the Daily cash book
- Lists with a right-click menu show a small mouse icon in the header; active filters appear as chips next to "Clear filters" and can be removed one by one
- Cheques / notes: status buttons above the list; correcting a cheque record keeps its payment type, and a moved cheque is no longer offered for correction
- Opening balances: a wrong opening record can be cancelled before the first day close, and corrected with a reversing record afterwards; cheques are entered as collections, not as carried-over cash; carried-over amounts use the usual number format
- The account type can be changed even when the account has records
- Projects report: choose a project by name in the detail
- Transfers: a ready-made "Gift voucher → Bank" choice
- Fixed: an "Account to income" record showed as a receivable; installment plan preview in collections; translated categories in the opening import template
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
